projects.name: t'au
projects.blurb: Memory-first zero-trust harness: every agent turn gets a goal, evidence, receipt, and a stop condition.
projects.question: Can an agent turn carry its own stop condition?

projects.name: battle
projects.blurb: Red/blue exploit evolution in isolated Docker targets, scored by deterministic proof gates.
projects.question: Can evolved exploit code be judged by proof instead of plausibility?

projects.name: surf
projects.blurb: Browser transport for agents — authenticated Chrome, element refs, screenshots, proven tab provenance.
projects.question: Can an agent prove which real browser tab actually answered?

projects.name: persona-dream
projects.blurb: Preregistered study: dreams as inspectable intermediates whose certified affect drives the persona’s live voice — emotion tags, tone, identity held stable.
projects.question: Does dreaming help a persona beyond remembering?

projects.name: extractor
projects.blurb: Zero-choice document extraction: one file in, one truthful result envelope out.
projects.question: Can document extraction hide every knob and still tell the truth?

projects.name: dogpile
projects.blurb: Multi-source research with traceable citations and honest used/skipped/degraded provider reporting.
projects.question: Can a research sweep admit which sources it failed to reach?

projects.name: watch
projects.blurb: Video into timestamped frames, transcript, and reports — evidence agents can re-query from memory.
projects.question: Can video become timecode-aligned evidence an agent can query later?

projects.name: scillm
projects.blurb: One execution surface for any model — chat, image, batch, tools, agents, receipts.
projects.question: Can provider glue live in one place instead of every skill?

projects.name: debugger
projects.blurb: Real breakpoints and paused-frame state — prove runtime truth before patching.
projects.question: What was true at the moment the bug happened?

projects.name: sparta explorer
projects.blurb: Space-cyber evidence threads traced to human decisions — relevance never becomes authority.
projects.question: Can AI surface evidence without acquiring approval authority?
